request: When Contains or NotContains receives a container value that len() cannot be applied to (for example a plain struct), the assertion fails with the same message for both: the %#v rendering of the container followed by ' could not be applied builtin len()'.

defects.description: Published bug fixed upstream: assert: fix error message formatting for NotContains (#1362)
defects.why_missed: The project's own suite at the parent commit never exercised this input; the fix commit added the test that does.
